title: The reproducible container: the declared image, its user, its pin, and what it verifies
note: CV1-CV7: the image running as root, its base pinned by tag, the in-image verification losing its fail-closed shell options or its content audit or its suite, the workflow no longer asserting the user, and the .dockerignore hiding governed evidence from the image. CV8-CV10: the step record a job log's tail must carry -- the EXIT trap, the completed-step list, and the name of the step that failed.

mutations.name: CV1_the_image_runs_as_root
mutations.rationale: the governed verification runs with every privilege the image has

mutations.name: CV2_the_base_is_pinned_by_tag
mutations.rationale: a moved tag silently changes the environment every run certifies

mutations.name: CV3_a_failing_step_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: a failing check in the image no longer stops the verification, which still reports complete

mutations.name: CV4_the_content_audit_is_not_run_in_the_image
mutations.rationale: the image verifies a tree it never checked for retired content

mutations.name: CV5_the_suite_is_not_run_in_the_image
mutations.rationale: the container reports success without running the tests

mutations.name: CV6_the_workflow_accepts_any_user
mutations.rationale: an image that runs as root passes the hosted check

mutations.name: CV7_governed_evidence_is_hidden_from_the_image
mutations.rationale: the image lacks governed files, and the in-image manifest check can only fail or be weakened

mutations.name: CV8_the_container_forgets_how_far_it_got
mutations.rationale: without the EXIT trap the step record is only readable by scrolling to a part of the log the API does not serve, and nothing at all is printed on failure

mutations.name: CV9_a_completed_step_is_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: the summary would say no step completed, so a run's progress is an inference again

mutations.name: CV10_the_failing_step_is_not_named
mutations.rationale: a failure would report how far the script got but not where it stopped
